sources.attribution: Triomi MangaDex public API adapter; stable mangadex source identity, Chinese chapters and data-saver support; no APK code copied.

Komiic public GraphQL guest reading port, modified from maintained E-extensions; official komiic.cc transport with canonical .com work/chapter identity. Embedded Apache license and modification notice. Account login/refresh and sponsorship are not ported; site quota/auth enforced.
Independently authored official xkcd JSON API adapter. Latest issues and number/URL search only; official API does not provide arbitrary title search.

Independent ManHuaGui public HTML/data port with explicit selection among four official HTTPS mirrors and canonical work/chapter identity. Bounded LZ/word decoding treats website scripts as data; no eval or page-script execution. Hidden/restricted chapters are not unlocked.

Independently authored Traditional Chinese WEBTOON public HTML and official mobile episode-catalog adapter. No login/paid/app-only episode bypass or signed image rewriting; no upstream implementation copied.

Independently authored official Chinese BH3 public HTML/JSON adapter. Full catalog and local title filtering, numerically ordered public chapters and original HTTPS images. No Android app bridge or website script execution.

Independent official Chinese Terra Historicus and Talos-II public JSON adapter. Topic-qualified IDs, complete ordered episodes, bounded four-worker page URL resolution and fresh signatures on chapter reload. No image-403 interception or entitlement bypass.

Independent Kuaikan public catalog/search and free chapter adapter. Bounded Nuxt literal/alias data parsing without executing website code; paid, login, age and app-only access restrictions remain enforced.
Independent public MH1234 desktop/mobile HTML protocol port. Literal reader redirects, ordered public pages and refreshed signed image URLs; no page-script execution or account/access-control bypass.
Independent public Guazi HTML adapter with server pagination, search and grouped chapter reading order; literal reader data only, no external JavaScript execution.

Independent public Miaoqu browse/detail/reader adapter. Website search currently returns HTTP 404: no search export or capability is advertised. Data-only bounded image decoding; no arbitrary webpage evaluation.
Independent official Iqiyi public comic API adapter with request signing, ordered chapters/pages and explicit paid/authPass rejection. No account identity or access-control bypass.

Independent Simplified Chinese Dongman official public web adapter. Distinct source/host from Traditional WEBTOON, complete public chapter pagination and original image URLs; no paid or app-only unlocking.

Independent public Webmota HTML/AMP adapter mapped to the owned BaoziManhuaPlus catalog identity. Complete in-chapter pagination with overlap deduplication; no upstream implementation copied, app-only or verification requirements are not bypassed.
Independent public GoDa HTML/API reader with bounded data-only page decoding and complete page ordering. No website-code evaluation, binary image transformation or verification bypass.
Independent public guest Zaimanhua chapter adapter preserving editions, numeric reading order and signed HD URLs. Public PC metadata fallback only; no login, entitlement or image-interceptor bypass.
Independent public Zazhimi magazine index/search/show API adapter. One complete issue is one chapter, all page order preserved; general magazines rather than a manga-only catalog.

Independent CopyManga App API protocol implementation aligned with the current 1.4.85 Android extension. Anonymous reading, full grouped catalog pagination and page ordering; optional native Triomi 178 settings/account/text discussion support. No website script execution, access-control bypass or credentials bundled.

Independent WNACG public HTML adapter with inert document.writeln decoding and balanced image-array parsing, preserving every ordered page and excluding the exact site bookmark banner. Official .buzz mirror, NSFW retained. No native gateway, credentials or website script execution.

Independent public E-Hentai adapter, modified for released Triomi 178 generic JS: selected-gallery chapters of ten pages, script-side HTTPS image resolution. No native page resolver, ExHentai, account, quota bypass or image-transform dependency. Refresh chapters to renew expired URLs. Fix: allow valid HTTPS ports for official .hath.network image nodes while retaining other host, quota and verification restrictions.

Independent Triomi jmcomic rule. Native JmcomicClient API decryption and binary JM image restoration; native support exists in app commit 67ce2cd4b9b9c0a87dcf556d0eb3aa9951634da2, NOT official iOS178 (0c27925). No account credentials or signing constants included in this catalog. Installation alone does not add native support.
sources.hostRequirements: Native JmcomicClient API decryption and binary JM image restoration. Requires Triomi app commit 67ce2cd4b9b9c0a87dcf556d0eb3aa9951634da2 or a compatible successor; official iOS178 commit 0c27925 is unsupported. Same version label 0.12.0+178 is insufficient. Host179 declares and enforces requiresHost; legacy clients ignore this field.

sources.attribution: Independent Triomi picacomic rule. Native PicacomicJsSource secure account/signing gateway and system secure storage; native support exists in app commit 67ce2cd4b9b9c0a87dcf556d0eb3aa9951634da2, NOT official iOS178 (0c27925). No account credentials or signing constants included in this catalog. Installation alone does not add native support.
sources.hostRequirements: Native PicacomicJsSource secure account/signing gateway and system secure storage. Requires Triomi iOS181 (0.12.0+181) or a successor declaring picacomic.account.v3, which sends the reference protocol empty Authorization header on sign-in and safely classifies HTTP 400 responses. Host179/180 are unsupported by rule 1.0.4. Initial native implementation: 67ce2cd4b9b9c0a87dcf556d0eb3aa9951634da2. Legacy clients ignore requiresHost; update the application before installing this rule. Rule 1.0.4 only fixes single-page catalog pagination; full episode/image traversal retains the 200-page and 20,000-item budgets. Authorized account acceptance through host181 production login and category path passed; real JS catalog, detail, images and reading remain unverified.
